sources.title: Handling Update Conflicts — PowerSync documentation
sources.released_version_or_commit: Documentation repository main branch; no release tag or commit SHA displayed (UNKNOWN).
sources.locator: Sections on server-authoritative reconciliation, ordered upload queue, idempotent operations and backend validation (rendered lines 192–212).
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary documentation page and read the conflict and operation-handling passages.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The backend application dictates how queued mutations are applied; the simplest example is per-field LWW; operations can be replayed and must be idempotent; backend validation/custom conflict handling is available.
sources.applicability: Supports the investigator's qualification that PowerSync-style sync does not itself supply this domain's stale-transition or duplicate-claim policy.

sources.title: Apache CouchDB 3.5 replication and conflict model
sources.released_version_or_commit: Apache CouchDB documentation 3.5 stable branch; exact patch release not pinned.
sources.locator: Sections 2.3.1–2.3.4 on replication, deterministic winner, revision branches, conflict visibility and application merge (rendered lines 19–57, 82–135).
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary documentation page and read the replication/conflict model through the application-resolution passages.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Replicated branches can coexist; ordinary reads expose only the deterministic winner; clients must query conflicts and perform application-specific merging/resolution.
sources.applicability: Supports treating CouchDB/PouchDB as a replication alternative that still needs user-visible conflict handling for handover state.

sources.title: Apache CouchDB database security API
sources.released_version_or_commit: Apache CouchDB documentation 3.5 stable branch; exact patch release not pinned.
sources.locator: GET /{db}/_security, members/admins behavior and default membership (rendered lines 5–35).
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary API page and read its member/admin permission and empty-membership passages.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Members can read database documents and write non-design documents; when membership lists are empty, regular document reads/writes are broadly allowed; newly created CouchDB 3.x databases default to admin-only.
sources.applicability: Shows that shared access depends on explicit database and document authorization design; it cannot determine the center's role or identity policy.

sources.title: Automerge conflict reference
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Automerge documentation; no release/commit pin displayed; copyright states 2026.
sources.locator: Conflicts section on concurrent same-property writes, getConflicts, and operation-ID ordering (rendered lines 58–112).
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary reference and read same-property conflict behavior and its ordering rule.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Concurrent updates to one property have a deterministic displayed winner while other values remain queryable through getConflicts; ordering uses operation counter and actor ID, not wall-clock time.
sources.applicability: Supports bounding Automerge to note collaboration unless the application adds explicit task/issue transition and conflict-review rules.
